calibration.title: Scale Calibration Certificate
calibration.pointsHint: Enter the values from the certificate: the certified standard weight used (nominal) and the value the scale indicated. Error in g and % is calculated for you and judged against the equipment's acceptance criterion.
calibration.empty: No calibration points yet — click "Add calibration point" and enter the values from the certificate
calibration.summaryOutside: Out of tolerance — do not use until recalibrated
calibration.summaryNoTolerance: No acceptance criterion (tolerance %) set for this equipment

inspection.title: Scheduled inspection (equipment inspection registry)
inspection.preUseHint: Requires an inspection record before this equipment is used in production — one pass covers the whole day, so it is not re-inspected again the same day
inspection.intervalDaysPlaceholder: e.g. 30 = inspect every 30 days (blank = no schedule)
inspection.checklistPlaceholder:
e.g.
Clean filter
Measure air temperature
Check for leaks
